pdf_page_count raises an error when the input is not a PDF

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import Xberg

do {
    let pdfBytesData = try Data(contentsOf: URL(fileURLWithPath: "text/plain.txt"))
    let pdfBytesBytes = Array(pdfBytesData)
    _ = try Xberg.pdfPageCount(pdfBytes: pdfBytesBytes)
} catch {
    print("\(type(of: error)): \(error)")
}
```
